prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 9:16 luxury-lounge fashion editorial featuring two distinct original adult women. One has voluminous wavy blonde hair and wears a soft-pink satin blouse with wide-leg evening trousers; the other has wavy auburn hair and wears a deep-purple satin blazer with tailored trousers. Add minimal unbranded hoops and bracelets. Place one seated upright in a vintage armchair and the other standing beside its armrest, both with relaxed hands and composed direct editorial gazes. Use a rich wooden wall, deep red velvet chairs, softly blurred lounge background, and neon blue, purple, and gold ambient lighting. Keep eyes and fabrics sharp, skin natural, satin reflections restrained, and exclude text, logos, celebrity likenesses, and sexualized posing.
